text:
Mq6 has W=0.8113, while every other Mq (and the mirror diode Mb2) has W=5.409. That makes the stage-6 PMOS current source about 6.7× weaker. The output stage driving vout is therefore starved on its pull-up side and can't swing vout up to the rail, which explains why swing fails while frequency and power still pass. Mq6 also has the largest swing sensitivity.
